$comment: Scoped npm-audit allowlist consumed by scripts/ship.mjs (the /ship gate). Each entry is a High+ advisory with NO non-breaking upstream fix, triaged as not reachable in this template. RULE: every id here MUST have a matching row in SECURITY.md §13 (tracked CVE remediations) and §12 (suppression log). Re-audit on every dependency bump; delete the entry the moment a fix ships or reachability changes. A High+ advisory NOT listed here still fails /ship.
